name: Trello
summary: This guide describes how to connect an external integration to Trello by creating a new Power-Up, generating API credentials, and authorizing user access with token-based authentication. Trello requires every integration to have its own app (Power-Up), and access to user data is granted through user-specific tokens obtained after user consent.
decision: To set up OAuth access to Trello, you must create your own Power-Up using the admin portal, generate an API Key (Client ID) and Secret, and then direct users to the Trello authorization URL to grant access and receive their user-specific access token. Trello does not offer a managed shared app for general API integrations, so you must use your own app credentials.

auth_type.value: Token-based authentication using API Key and user-specific token (similar to OAuth flow)
auth_type.note: API Key uniquely identifies your Power-Up, and each user must grant access to receive an access token.

setup_path.label: Create and use your own Trello Power-Up for all integrations.
setup_path.note: The onboarding process requires you to create your own app; there is no public Trello app for general OAuth API use.

difficulty.note: The steps are straightforward, but manual interaction with the Power-Ups portal is required. The retrieved pages do not state this in matching language.

approval_wait.note: No reviewer or approval queue is described for creating your own app or Power-Up; you have immediate access once you have a Trello account.

prerequisites.title: Trello Account
prerequisites.body: A registered Trello account is required to access the Power-Ups admin portal and create a Power-Up.

prerequisites.title: Access Power-Ups Admin Portal
prerequisites.body: You must use the Power-Ups admin portal at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin instead of the deprecated /app-key page.
prerequisites.note: The /app-key page is replaced by the Power-Ups admin portal.

steps.title: Log in to Trello
steps.body: Sign in with your Trello account at https://id.atlassian.com/login.

steps.title: Open Power-Ups Admin Portal
steps.body: Navigate to https://trello.com/power-ups/admin to manage or create Power-Ups.

steps.title: Create a New Power-Up
steps.body: Click 'New', then provide the required information such as Power-Up name, Workspace, Email, Support contact, Author, and Iframe connector URL.
steps.note: Minimal placeholder values are acceptable if you are not building a UI.

steps.title: Generate API Key and Secret
steps.body: After creating your Power-Up, open it, go to the API Key tab, and select 'Generate a new API Key'. Copy the displayed API Key and Secret.
steps.note: Both the API Key and Secret are shown in the Power-Up settings.

steps.title: Configure Allowed Origins
steps.body: Set the Allowed Origins to include any URLs where Trello should be permitted to redirect users after authorization (your app's OAuth callback URIs).
steps.note: Redirect will be blocked if the return_url does not match.

steps.title: Receive and Store Access Token
steps.body: After the user clicks 'Allow', Trello will redirect according to your parameters and return a user-specific access token, which you should securely store.
steps.note: Do not share or commit tokens to source control.

steps.title: Verify Credentials Functionality
steps.body: Make a test API request (e.g., GET https://api.trello.com/1/members/me?key=YOUR_API_KEY&token=YOUR_TOKEN) to confirm the API Key and token combination works.

human_actions.title: Sign in to Trello
human_actions.body: Log in at https://id.atlassian.com/login with your Trello credentials.

human_actions.title: Access Power-Ups Portal
human_actions.body: Go to https://trello.com/power-ups/admin to begin the application setup.

human_actions.title: Create Power-Up
human_actions.body: Fill in the new Power-Up creation form and submit it.

human_actions.title: Generate and Copy Credentials
human_actions.body: Click to generate your API Key (Client ID) and Secret and copy them securely.
human_actions.note: Keep the Secret and any user tokens private.

human_actions.title: Set Allowed Origins
human_actions.body: Manually configure allowed redirect URIs for your integration in the app settings.

human_actions.title: Authorize App for User
human_actions.body: Visit the authorization URL in your browser, review requested scopes, and click 'Allow'.

human_actions.title: Copy User Access Token
human_actions.body: After allowing, copy and store the returned token securely.

human_actions.title: Test the Integration
human_actions.body: Call the Trello API (e.g., GET user info) using your new credentials to confirm everything works.
